newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic adds 2 sizes of VectorX in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic adds 2 sizes of VectorX in U.S.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Tuesday it released commercially in the United States two additional sizes of its VectorX coronary guiding catheter.
The company now offers VectorX in 6- and 7-French sizes as well as the 8-French size.

Guiding catheters are used as conduits by interventional cardiologists to help guide devices such as balloon catheters and stents to lesion sites in the coronary arteries during percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA).

"The addition of 6- and 7-French VectorX guiding catheters to our successful 8-French VectorX product line will provide physicians with new choices in difficult angioplasty and stenting procedures," David Lentz, general manager of Medtronic Interventional Vascular, said in a statement.
Medtronic specializes in implantable and interventional medical therapies.
